facts.fact: Vetogate reports that the Ministries of Justice and of Communications launched on 7 November 2026 a remote litigation power of attorney service that uses AI techniques in the digital identity app to verify the citizen's identity, capacity and intent.

systems.system: Remote general litigation power of attorney
systems.owner: Ministry of Justice; Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

EGY.note: AI is used in a notarial identity check; that is administration, not a sector's management system outputs.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in the country.

facts.fact: Vetogate reports that the Ministries of Justice and of Communications launched on 7 November 2026 a remote power of attorney service that verifies identity through the digital identity app and completes it with an approved electronic signature.

Vetogate reports that citizens prove identity online in the digital identity app by a face scan matched to the biometric record in state databases, to obtain a remote power of attorney through the Digital Egypt platform from 7 November 2026.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

EGY.note: Nothing on civil register and ID link.
Mentions data protection controls only in passing; no law stated.
States an approved electronic signature but no law, rule or licence.

facts.fact: Vetogate reports that the Digital Egypt platform offers about 22 notarial and real estate registry services online, 16 notarial and 6 registry, including powers of attorney with online fee payment.

systems.owner: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

EGY.note: Nothing on a number at birth.

Biometric match is a verification, not enrolment de-duplication; no certification or coverage stated.
